name: PandaDoc
description: PandaDoc is a document management platform for creating, sending, tracking, and eSigning proposals, quotes, and contracts, with CPQ, embedded payment collection, and CRM integrations on its higher tiers.
best_for: Sales and operations teams that want proposal creation, e-signatures, and, on higher tiers, CPQ and payment collection in one connected document workflow.
features: Drag-and-drop document editor with reusable templates and a content library
Legally-binding eSignatures with configurable signing order and recipient identity verification
CPQ (configure-price-quote) with a product catalog and rules-based pricing, on the Enterprise plan
Deal rooms and approval workflows for collaborative agreement negotiation
Payment collection embedded directly inside documents
Real-time document tracking, audit trail, and recipient analytics
CRM integrations (including Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pipedrive) plus webhooks and an API
Mobile app for creating, tracking, approving, and signing documents on a phone or iPad

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: For small businesses needing basic eSign. Includes 60 documents per year, 5 legally-binding eSignatures/month, 5 documents sent/month, and 24/7 email and chat support. No credit card required.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Billed annually ("Save up to 46%" vs. monthly billing, exact monthly rate not published on the pricing page). Unlimited document uploads and eSignatures. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Marked "Most Popular." Billed annually. Adds custom quotes/sales agreements, CRM integrations, custom branding and content library, deal rooms, approval workflows, web forms, and bulk send.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Per-seat or per-document pricing; contact sales ("Let's talk"). Adds CPQ, workflow automation, smart content, single sign-on (SSO), team workspaces, notary, and API access.

pros: Publishes exact self-serve per-seat pricing for the Free, Starter, and Business tiers rather than gating everything behind a sales call
The Free plan supports real e-signatures (5/month) and document sends, not just a time-limited trial
States SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliance on its pricing page, plus eIDAS and U.S. ESIGN Act of 2000 support for electronic signatures
cons: Free and Starter plans bill extra per document once you exceed the plan's allowance: $3.50/document on Starter Monthly, $2 on Starter Annual, and $2.60 on Business Monthly, per its pricing FAQ
CPQ, workflow automation, SSO, and full API access are reserved for the Enterprise (contact-sales) tier
HIPAA compliance is listed as an optional add-on on the pricing page's feature-comparison table rather than included by default

faq.question: Does PandaDoc have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. PandaDoc's Free plan is $0 and includes 60 documents per year, 5 eSignatures/month, and 5 documents sent/month, per its pricing page.

faq.question: How much does PandaDoc cost?
faq.answer: On the annual-billing view, Starter is $19/seat/month and Business is $49/seat/month. Enterprise uses per-seat or per-document custom pricing via a sales quote.

faq.question: Will I be charged when I start a PandaDoc trial?
faq.answer: No. PandaDoc's pricing FAQ states you are only charged after your 14-day free trial evaluation if you choose to continue.

faq.question: Is PandaDoc SOC 2 certified?
faq.answer: PandaDoc's pricing page lists "SOC 2 Type II compliance" and states data is encrypted in transit and stored in a SOC, FISMA, and PCI DSS Level 1 compliant cloud.

alternatives.name: Jotform
alternatives.description: A no-code online form builder for collecting submissions, payments, and operational data through customizable forms and workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams whose primary need is lightweight, form-based document and payment collection rather than a full proposal/CPQ/e-signature suite.
